transliteration:
pratirūpakarāś caiva maṅgaloddeśavṛttayaḥ |
ity evamādayo jñeyāḥ prakāśalokavañcakāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who counterfeit forms, manipulate auspicious occasions, and conduct deceptive practices under the guise of illumination are to be recognized as perpetrators of conscious distortion.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from ontological integrity, not performative display.
Causation is traced through intent alignment with dharma-svarūpa.
Capacity-based responsibility arises when one distorts pramāṇa for personal gain.
Restoration logic requires re-alignment of false representation with satya-svarūpa.
Consciousness alignment mandates cessation of deception and return to śuddha-vyavahāra.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent performs pratirūpa (counterfeit form) THEN initiate vyavahāra-shuddhi protocol.
IF maṅgaloddeśa is exploited for deceptive gain THEN trigger dharma-realization injunction.
IF prakāśaloka is used to mask adharmic action THEN enforce satyāgraha completion process.
IF intent shows alignment with pratirūpa THEN invoke svabhāva-sthiti restoration mechanism.
IF pratirūpa-causality disrupts community trust THEN activate samāna-bodha reintegration cycle.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that acts of impersonation, false ritual performance, or misuse of sacred symbols must be adjudicated by tracing the causal chain back to consciousness distortion. The threshold of responsibility lies in the intentional misrepresentation of dharma for material or social gain. Authority is derived from alignment with sanātana-dharma, not ceremonial exhibition.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that pratirūpa arises from avidyā and causes further distortion in collective consciousness. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how such actions sequentially degrade societal trust. Proportional responsibility is measured by the extent of distortion caused. The non-punitive reality rule dictates that correction occurs through reintegration, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pratirūpa-nivṛtti process to dissolve counterfeit patterns.
Engage maṅgala-prakāśa śuddhi to restore authentic celebration.
Activate prakāśaloka-sthiti rectification to realign luminous truth.
Implement svabhāva-sthiti pratipatti for perpetrator consciousness reset.
Establish samāna-bodha platform for community re-trust building.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored through recognition and dissolution of counterfeit consciousness. Reality remains non-punitive, governed solely by the supremacy of pure awareness. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
